svg.title: DNP, the drug HU6 turns into: reported poisonings and deaths
svg.desc: DNP, the drug HU6 turns into: reported poisonings and deaths. Cases: 2010: 4, 2015: 71, 2019: 53. Case fatality: 38 countries, 2010 to Sept 2020: 11.9%, US 2007-2018: 11.6%, UK 2007-2018: 16.9%.

text.font-family: Inter, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
